title: Staff band at WSMB and jazz at the 500 Club
summary: Hazel was on the WSMB staff band and at Leon Prima's 500 Club, where jazz was played only between shows.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: And, uh, uh, and I was working at the 500 Club then. Leon Prima had the 500 Club then. That was before their revival, you know. Yes. You had to, you had to really scuffle around and start to try to hear any jazz. As a matter of fact, for a good while, we had, you know, we were playing the only jazz in New Orleans, because the rest of the bands would either go on Latin or go on arrangements and things that you couldn't hear in the real jazz. Yeah, those were tough days for traditional music, weren't they? And we only, we only played it in between shows. The show was the big thing. We had the Catgirl and the Christine and things like that and do about 10, 11 shows a night. And we'd probably play three tunes in between. And I played it, the clarinet, you know, with the drums, Leon would, Leon would just play the show.
